name: Fear

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self 30-foot cone WIS save; failed targets drop held items and become Frightened; Dash and safe escape each turn; save at end of turn only when no caster line of sight.

rules.text: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.
A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move.
If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn’t have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.
